basic_info.description: Welcome to this charming 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom home in the vibrant Bernal Heights of San Francisco. With 925 sq ft of living space, this residence offers a comfortable and inviting environment. The flooring throughout the home includes both carpet and hardwood. The living room features a fireplace. Bedroom has amazing twin peak view's. Ample storage space. The home also includes a central forced air heating system and a gas hookup for laundry. Located on a lot of approximately 2,979 sq ft, this home also includes a garage space. This property falls within the San Francisco Unified Elementary School District. Don't miss the opportunity to own this delightful home in one of San Francisco's desirable neighborhoods.
